'''F3-T2''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] aboard [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
F3-T2 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as the Republic Flashpoint courier for the [[Assault on Tython]] Flashpoint, though the droid is only found aboard Carrick Station and not on other planets like other couriers.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' {{1st}}
